title: The Four-Stage Commitment Spectrum
scopeLimits: Distinguishes stages from costless interest to binding execution with associated dissolution risks.
limitations: Conceptual model; does not quantify monetary escrow thresholds.

accessibility.altText: A four-stage progression from Expressed Interest, to Ratification, to Conditional Commitment, to Binding Execution.
accessibility.textEquivalent: Four stages: 1. Expressed Interest (zero cost), 2. Ratification (alignment signal), 3. Conditional Commitment (contingent on terms), 4. Binding Execution (contractual lock-in). Dissolution risks shift across the spectrum.
